g.text: Designing an Emotionally Adaptive AI Companion
AffetX Emotionally Adaptive Companion Study Agreement
This application evaluates AI emotional adaptation accuracy and long-term memory fidelity.
Live microphone stream evaluates pitch, volume, and spectrograms in real-time.
Transcribed utterances are evaluated by RoBERTa for semantic emotional intent.
All audio is processed securely in volatile memory. No biometric identity is permanently stored.
You reserve the right to terminate session anytime with the exit button without penalty.
I have read and agree with the above terms and conditions
Participant consent has been confirmed successfully.
